correctness.rationale: For distinct edges each shortest route enters and leaves via one of four endpoints; same-edge direct travel is included. Independently checked exceptional geometry: two aligned horizontal edges in different rows (or vertical analogue) force D=k+min(S+T,2-S-T) versus ambient k+|S-T|. The excess is 2min(min(S,T),1-max(S,T)), whose survival is (1-z)^2. Orientation and edge counts give exception mass (m+n-2)/(4mn). All other edge pairs have D=L. Conditioning on orientations yields two independent circle-distance uniforms in mixed case; same-direction baseline and exceptional replacements supply the full CDF, including the coefficients 1/(4m),1/(4n),1/(4mn). Cyclic vertex-distance mean correction -ε_k/(4k) establishes mean and elementary parity inequality yields full sign classification. Independently checked 10,000 exact rational endpoint-route comparisons. Finite samples do not prove the exhaustive route lemma.
